sample_records.description: Standard consultation for common cold symptoms
sample_records.notes: Patient presented with runny nose, cough, and temperature of 38.2°C. No serious complications observed. Recommended rest and fluids.
medications: Paracetamol 500mg every 6 hours as needed for fever
sample_records.follow_up: Return if symptoms worsen or persist beyond 7 days

sample_records.notes: Patient reports feeling well. No complaints. All systems reviewed and within normal limits. Blood work ordered for routine screening.
Patient presents with high fever (39.1°C), body aches, fatigue, and dry cough. Rapid influenza test positive for Type A. Advised isolation and hydration.
medications: Ibuprofen 400mg every 6 hours for fever and pain

sample_records.notes: Patient reports good medication compliance. Blood pressure well-controlled. No side effects reported. Lifestyle modifications discussed including sodium restriction and regular exercise.
sample_records.follow_up: Return in 3 months for blood pressure check
